item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM is now generally available in all Azure public regions. It allows organizations with regulatory or sovereignty requirements to keep physical control of key-encryption keys while using Azure services that support this capability.

  • Source: Azure Updates
